label: Black Thursday market shock, USDC dip ~$0.97
note: 2020-03-12: Black Thursday crypto-wide crash; USDC briefly to ~$0.97

label: SVB reserve exposure and USDC depeg
note: 2023-03-11: Single pin for the SVB cluster (closure 03-10 → depeg low 03-11 → federal backstop announced 03-12, funds accessible 03-13). The chart already shows the recovery.

label: MiCA stablecoin regime in force, Circle EMI-authorized in EU
note: 2024-06-30: MiCA stablecoin (ART/EMT) provisions take effect; Circle became the first global issuer with an EU EMI license a day later. Marks the start of regulated EU issuance for USDC.
